name: io.glitchr.store
description: A window of the Unity editor that browses the package sources you add - a Forge, a static hub on GitHub Pages, any UPM registry, Git packages, a GitHub organisation's repositories matching a pattern, public or private - and installs, updates and removes their packages in the open project in one click, at the newest version or any older one, with the Git packages a Git package needs; profiles shared with Forge Hub (hubs kept per user, one active at a time); its Installed tab lists the project's packages from its manifest and lock (updated all at once, removed, samples imported, embedded). A store's licensing key is pinned on first use, in a file Forge Hub shares; licences open only the package and the registry they name, and a static hub's offline licences are pasted, checked and kept per user - on the packages its hub lists as sold, with a link to buy one. Open source and agnostic: no source is built in. A hub that sells is bought from in the browser, or in one click from the window once the editor is linked to a Forge that takes it (the price confirmed first); the key it brings is kept in the user's .upmconfig.toml.
